name: instance-model-row-layout
description: InstanceSheet .modelRow desktop geometry: .modelNameSlot shrinks and wraps a long unbroken model ID beside .modelMeta without pushing .modelMeta past the row's right edge.

mutation.note: Measured 2026-11-12: removing min-width: 0 and overflow-wrap: anywhere from .modelNameSlot causes the unbroken model label to spill 325.0px into .modelMeta instead of wrapping.
